request_summary: Review read-only in chat di tutti i feature Gherkin sotto src/integration.

actions.description: Read persona, scoped ACE instructions, Gherkin guidelines, and referenced profile.
Reviewed all 36 requested integration feature files in read-only mode, checking structure, language, tags, indentation, tracking comments, and scenario limits.
Returned grouped findings, file-specific findings, cross-file consistency, strengths, and validation friction without changes or tests.

outcome.detail: The orchestrator verified representative reported findings and confirmed all requested integration feature files remained unchanged.

friction.description: behave --lang-help it was unavailable; keyword validation relied on documented Gherkin language conventions.
The large review required block reads and some reported line references were estimates from the analyst's manual counting.
